title: Third-round editing command responsiveness improvements
scope: 30 new production command costs after activation, excluding startup/load times, the implemented earlier74, all round2 findings and merged code simplification work.
validation: 21 new focused work/compatibility tests include 520 exact frozen-base complete draft/result/error hashes. All 74 focused existing/new command tests passed. Strict test TypeScript reports no editing errors; final root canonical/Electron/browser gates are reported separately.

parity.coverage: Range process/keep/replace, one-hop A/V and linked-track targets, group/ungroup/join preflight/execution, bin move, descriptor and all four paste modes, with ordinary, duplicate clip/track/owner, missing membership, unowned, unsorted and A/V-chain drafts. Baseline drafts receive the baseline module runtime brand so duplicated-module admission does not bias comparison.

findings.change: Resolve A/V-only seeds through one first-match index instead of two linear clip searches per seed.

test.name: A/V range seeds resolve through one first-match index and retain duplicate output order

findings.evidence: 120 seeds: 14760 identity reads before, 360 after.
findings.limitations: Distinct from round2 transitive group/A-V expansion: range collection is one-hop A/V only. First duplicate authority and repeated output IDs are preserved.

test.name: linked-track ripple visits track memberships, A/V relationships and owners once per closure

measurementLimitations: Operation counters demonstrate removed production costs. Shared workflow counters are labeled combined and do not attribute individual wall-time savings. Local indexes allocate and snapshot only within one draft phase, and early-stopping requested indexes avoid unrelated tails. No Electron end-to-end latency/FPS or full-gate claim is made here.
helperCompatibility: First matching clip/track/owner authority and precise affected missing ReferenceErrors are retained. The A/V range collector is one-hop and excludes group expansion. Ambiguous duplicate or unowned linked-track documents retain legacy rounds. Clipboard sources/IDs are indexed only after collision mutations, additions stage before publication, duplicate pending IDs retain persisted admission authority, and source bounds, relationship carriers and normalizers remain unchanged. Callback-sensitive preparation caches and disjoint simulation clone reuse were deliberately excluded.
